extracted.intended_audience: eRA Commons users at NIH-grantee institutions (Signing Officials/AORs, PIs, delegates, TTO administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and quality rules for managing Institution and Personal Profiles, asserting institutional assurances/certifications, and tracking/submitting grant application status within the eRA Commons web application. Covers role-based permissions, expected field contents, status values, error/warning handling, and available actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: SO role required to edit Institution Profile
rubrics_metrics.description: Only Commons users with the SO role can edit the Institution Profile. An exception exists for institutions having a TTO Administrator and no Signing Official; for these institutions the TTO Administrator can edit all sections of the profile. For institutions with both a Signing Official and TTO Administrator, the TTO Administrator can only edit the Extramural Technology Transfer Administration component.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit role-based permission rule: edits to the Institution Profile are limited to SO users except the specified TTO Administrator exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Assurances & Certifications component contents
rubrics_metrics.description: The Institutional Assurances and Certifications component contains data elements that compose assurance/certification information (e.g., Human Subjects Assurance Number, IRB Approval Date, IRB Type, Animal Welfare Assurance Number, IACUC Unacknowledged Certification Explanation). The screen provides means of viewing and managing the checklist of these assurances and certifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Populate required assurance/certification fields accurately; consult Part III of the SF424 (R&R) Application Guide for full definitions and applicability. The component is viewable via the Assurances & Certifications link and is read-only for most users unless authorized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office of Research and Integrity Certification Status values
rubrics_metrics.description: The Status section displays the Office of Research and Integrity Certification Status for the institution. The values for this field are either 'Assurance OK' or 'Expired'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expired status displays in red text as a warning; the expiration date is shown and also displays in red if already expired. Institutions should maintain up-to-date certifications to avoid 'Expired' state.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assurances & Certifications indicate compliance categories
rubrics_metrics.description: The Assurances and Certification section lets institutions indicate (or view indication of) compliance with particular laws, policies, and/or regulations and that it meets certain research requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not all assurances/certifications are applicable to every institution; refer to SF424 (R&R) Application Guide for definitions. Read-only check marks and compliance dates display to users with profile access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-discrimination assurances list
rubrics_metrics.description: This institution complies with all laws, policies and regulations prohibiting discrimination based on: Age Discrimination Assurance; Civil Rights Assurance; Handicapped Individuals Assurance; Inclusion of Children Policy; Sex Discrimination Assurance; Women and Minority Inclusion Policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SO users check/uncheck the appropriate indicators; can provide explanatory text via '(explain your answer)' link. Ensure only applicable assurances are selected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Laws and regulations compliance assurances list
rubrics_metrics.description: This institution complies with all laws and regulations regarding: ClinicalTrials.gov Requirement; Conflict of Interest Assurance; Delinquent Debt Assurance; Drugfree Workplace Assurance; Impact of Grant Activities on the Environment and Historic Properties; Institutional Debarment Assurance; Lobbying Assurance; Smoke-Free Workplace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are explicit legal/regulatory compliance indicators; institutions must only mark those that apply and should have supporting documentation as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research-specific requirement indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Research at this institution meets all requirements for: Graduate Student Training for Doctoral Degrees (limited FOAs listed); Human Subjects; PI Assurance; Prohibited Research; Recombinant DNA and Human Gene Transfer; Research Misconduct; Research With Human Embryonic Stem Cells; Select Agent Research; Transplantation of Human Fetal Tissue; Vertebrate Animals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SO users mark these as applicable; special FOA-specific items (e.g., training programs) only apply to certain mechanisms — follow FOA guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editing Assurances workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: SO role users edit assurance/certification indicators by selecting the 'Edit Assurances and Certifications' button; indicators display over several categories and can be checked/unchecked; an '(explain your answer)' link opens a textbox for additional information; changes are saved with 'Save All' or discarded with 'Discard Changes'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only authorized users should edit; provide explanatory text when required. Use Save All to persist changes; do not navigate away without saving if changes are intended.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Profile module ownership and sections
rubrics_metrics.description: The Personal Profile is the central repository for all registered users; individuals hold and maintain ownership over the accuracy of their profile. Sections include Name and ID; Demographics; Employment; Reviewer Information; Trainee Information; Education; Reference Letters; Publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users may delegate authority to maintain their profile to other institutional users. Access to profile sections depends on Commons role. See Personal Profile Online Help for more detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status module core capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Status screens allow PD/PIs, their delegates, and SOs to: track the status of grant applications through submission, view all their applications and Notices of Award and other key documents, and complete several post-submission and post-award transactions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: What a user can see and do depends on their Commons role; query and results screens behave differently per user role. Refer to role-specific help topics for detailed actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search criteria for Recent/Pending eSubmissions and General Search
rubrics_metrics.description: Search criteria options include Accession Number, Grants.gov Tracking #, eSubmission Status (All, Pending Verification, Rejected), and Received Date (range entry via MM/DD/YYYY or calendar).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use appropriate identifiers to narrow results. Received Date accepts range queries. Grants.gov Tracking # is non-sortable in results. Accession Number is the pre-NIH unique value assigned to applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: eSubmission status checking and interpretation
rubrics_metrics.description: Check the 'eSubmission Status' column to determine if your application status is 'eSubmission Error' or 'Pending Verification'. Errors will stop the submission process and require a corrected application; warnings do not stop submission but must be reviewed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To view errors/warnings: (Method 1) select 'Show Prior Errors and Warnings' link, or (Method 2) if 'Pending Verification' select the Accession Number to open Status Information where messages display at top during the two-day review window. Address errors promptly; review warnings to determine applicability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reject eApplication requirements and steps
rubrics_metrics.description: Only Signing Officials can request rejection of an eSubmission, and the application must not have been previously verified or rejected by the SO. The Reject eApplication action requires entering a required comment (which becomes part of the rejection email) and selecting Reject (or Cancel). The contact PI receives email notification when rejected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an SO-only option; use it when warranted prior to verification. Compose a clear required comment because it is communicated to the PI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Re-assign Grant functional constraints and workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: Signing Officials may use 'Reassign Grant' to change the assignment of a grant from one existing department/component to another within their institution. This functionality is only available to SOs from institutions classified as Institutions of Higher Education and cannot create new departments or components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search for grants by grant number, contact PI name, or major Department/Component. You may move all grants visible on one page at a time; grants on multiple pages require multiple reassignments. Assignments are immediate in Commons and will appear in RePORTER the following Monday. Search criteria limited to current and future fiscal years for awarded grants or pending type 5 grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status Result general search display limits and sorting
rubrics_metrics.description: The Status Result - General Search screen limits 100 records per view; additional records accessed via page navigation. Results can be sorted by columns that display an up/down arrow in the column heading.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your result set is large, use paging; use column-sort arrows where available to order results. Be aware of the per-view limit when selecting grants to act upon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status Result fields and meanings
rubrics_metrics.description: Results include Application ID (link to Status Information; MPI indicator if multiple PIs), Grants.gov Tracking # (assigned by Grants.gov; non-sortable), Proposal Title (NFP appended when not forwarded for review), PD/PI Name, Application Status (Awarded, Pending, Withdrawn, Terminated, Not Funded, Returned, Received, eSubmission Error), Budget Start Date, FFATA indicator, Show All Prior Errors link, and Action links.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpret Application Status values to determine next steps. Use the Application ID link to view detailed Status Information. NFP in title indicates no referral for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Action links and their meanings in Status results
rubrics_metrics.description: The Action column contains context-dependent links such as RPPR (open progress report editing/submission), Public Access PRAM, IC Requested PRAM, Fellowship Face Page, Progress Report Face Page, JIT (Just In Time), Extension (No-Cost Extension), Closed, Requires Closeout, Reject eApplication (SO-only), Transmittal Sheet, Administrative Supplement status, Manage Relinquishing Statement, Relinquishing Statement, Sandy Quarterly Report, Inclusion (access IMS for inclusion enrollment data).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available actions vary per application. Some links open other modules (e.g., RPPR, IMS). To submit inclusion data with an RPPR, access IMS via RPPR Section G rather than the Status Inclusion link. Use the appropriate link for the task you need to perform.

rubrics_metrics.name: PI role landing options and ASST limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon entering Status, PI users see three options: Recent/Pending eSubmissions, List of Applications/Grants, and Search by Grants.gov Tracking Num. A PI may delegate an ASST role to view the Status module; ASSTs can view status results as the PI would but will not have access to the links in the Action column.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the landing options to access desired views. Delegations allow view-only access for ASSTs; PIs retain control over actionable links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent/Pending eSubmissions inclusion criteria and table fields
rubrics_metrics.description: The Recent/Pending eSubmissions view returns applications that require action prior to submission, applications available for viewing prior to submission (2 business day correction window), and applications that have been refused by the SO. Table fields include Grants.gov Tracking #, Application ID (link), eSubmission Status, Proposal Title (NFP note), PD/PI Name, eSubmission Status Date, Show All Prior Errors, and export buttons to Excel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the two-business-day window to view submission errors and warnings. Export results to Excel as needed. Use 'Show Prior Errors' to review prior failed submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of Applications/Grants grouping (grant families) and expanded info
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are initially collapsed into grant families showing application number (or 'Application ID Not Yet Assigned'), number of applications/grants in the family, contact PD/PI, and title. Expanding a family shows Application ID, Grants.gov Tracking #, Proposal Title, PD/PI Name, eSubmission Status, Current Application Status, Status Date, and Available Actions (buttons).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the plus sign to expand families. The screen shows aggregated and per-application details and provides same action links as other Status views.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search by Grants.gov Tracking Number behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Searching by Grants.gov Tracking Number returns only the application matching the entered tracking number. Errors/Warnings for prior failed submissions can be viewed via the 'Show Prior Errors and Warnings' button.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter the exact Grants.gov Tracking # to retrieve the single matching application. Use 'Show Prior Errors' to inspect earlier submission attempts.

rubrics_metrics.name: PI viewing window for submission status
rubrics_metrics.description: The designated Contact PD/PI can view status information relating to newly submitted applications during the 'viewing window' — the first two business days after submission up to the submission deadline. After the deadline, applications that remain in Pending status will also be visible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this window to inspect errors/warnings and submission status. If issues are found, coordinate with SO/AOR as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status Information screen contents and error placement
rubrics_metrics.description: Status Information is a collection of grant information and links; if unresolved errors/warnings exist they display at the top of the Status Information screen. Sections include General Grant Information (Status, Institution Name, School, Department, PI Name, Application ID, Proposal Title, Proposal Receipt Date, Last Status Update Date, Current Award Notice Date, Application Source, Project Period Begin/End Date, eApplication Status, FOA, NIH Appl ID), Other Relevant Documents (list of possible documents such as Abstract, e-Application, Notices of Grant Award, Summary Statement, PRAM, etc.), Correspondence (date, description, link to PDF), and Status History (Effective Date, Status Message).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Status Information to find all relevant grant metadata and uploaded documents. Address any errors/warnings shown at the top before proceeding with downstream actions.
